name: requirement-analysis
description: 多格式需求文档分析与整合。自动解析 Markdown、Excel、Word、思维导图文件，智能去重和补充需求信息，生成标准化的 PRD.md 文档。
description_en: Multi-format requirement document analysis and integration. Automatically parse Markdown, Excel, Word, and mind map files, intelligently deduplicate and supplement requirement info, and generate standardized PRD.md documents.
features: 飞书/Git/FTP/Obsidian/剪贴板多目标推送
